name: Cloudflarechy
author: yamz8
description: One Cloudflare zone from the Omarchy bar: 24h traffic, cache ratio, tunnels, and the two switches you forget to turn off

barWidget.description: Cloudflare zone traffic, cache, tunnels and workers

schema.label: Zone
schema.description: The domain to show, e.g. example.com. Leave empty to use the first zone the token can read.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the widget polls Cloudflare in the background. The bar dot is only as fresh as this.

schema.label: Show Cloudflare Tunnels
schema.description: Needs Account → Cloudflare Tunnel → Read on the token.

schema.label: Show recent Workers
schema.description: Needs Account → Workers Scripts → Read on the token.

schema.label: Dot on the bar icon when something needs attention
schema.description: Development Mode on, Under Attack Mode on, or a tunnel down or degraded.
